description: Bridge Structural Health Monitoring Dataset: Train-Induced Vibration Data Under Multiple Damage Scenarios is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Cássio Bragança, Marissa Silva (Universidade de São Paulo). Simulated acceleration time-series dataset from a railway bridge structure under train loading with varying operational and environmental conditions. Contains vibration measurements from 18 sensor nodes (3-axis accelerometers) sampled at 256 Hz. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
